localizationRule.futureOnly: For an approved future locale, retain the shared 70 px safe margins and common v3 phone geometry with intentional bottom-only viewport clipping. Rewrap at word boundaries, then decrement font size by 1 px down to the declared floor; at most two headline/subtitle lines. If it still fails, stop for an approved layout revision, never rewrite, truncate, condense or stretch copy. RTL requires a shaping-capable engine (RAQM), start-aligned marketing text, and separate source/crop QA; native pixels, the LTR native wordmark, and physical Keep-up/Trash-left/Later-right gesture semantics must never be mirrored. No translations or other locale exports are implemented here.
